effect.name: Scene Cuts
effect.description: Find where the shot changes, and cut the clip there on its own track
effect.author: Wunjo

parameter.name: sc_threshold
Sensitivity
parameter.comment: How much of the frame must change to count as a new shot. Lower finds more cuts, and starts calling a pan one.

parameter.name: sc_min_shot
Shortest shot
parameter.comment: Cuts closer together than this are read as one — a dissolve scores twice otherwise.

parameter.name: sc_generate
Analyse
parameter.jobparam: Nothing analysed yet. This looks for shot changes and reports where they fall — the clip itself is not touched
